meta.source: hand-assembled from supamem + fastapi-style fixture for offline CI
meta.notes: Mirrors Phase 14 D-SMOKE-01 size budget (<=200 KB). Each question carries a small inline haystack of (path, content) stubs sufficient for an offline retrieval pass; full corpus + queries are produced by 15-C against the pinned manifest.

questions.text:
Add transcript chunker plugin entry-point

Register the new transcript chunker via the supamem.chunker plugin group so third parties can swap chunkers without forking.

haystack.content: T-1 markdown header chunker. chunk_markdown splits on h1/h2/h3 then caps with RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter. Forward-compat seam for transcript chunker registration via supamem.chunker entry-point group.
supamem dual-memory CLI for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode.

questions.text:
Pin pinned-SHA fetch via subprocess + git CLI

Deterministic two-repo haystack pipeline backed by git init + git fetch --depth=1 origin SHA. Never shell=True; pinned URL list is a Python literal.

haystack.content: fetch_pinned runs git init -> remote add origin -> fetch --depth=1 origin <sha> -> checkout FETCH_HEAD. HEAD verified == pinned sha; mismatch wipes cache and refetches. Cache rooted at platformdirs.user_cache_dir("supamem")/coderag.
Eval-isolated ingest into supamem_eval_coderag collection. Idempotent payload index DDL on repo + axis.

questions.text:
Add APIRoute include_in_schema=False support

Allow individual routes to be excluded from the OpenAPI schema while remaining discoverable to the router.

haystack.content: APIRoute and APIRouter classes; include_in_schema kwarg propagates to OpenAPI generator. add_api_route handles route registration; route matching via Starlette's compile_path.
FastAPI app entry-point class wraps Starlette.
FastAPI is a modern, fast (high-performance), web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard Python type hints.

questions.text:
Dependency overrides for testing

Allow overriding declared Depends() callables at the app level so tests can substitute fakes without monkeypatching the route signatures.

haystack.content: solve_dependencies walks the dependency tree; app.dependency_overrides dict is consulted before the original callable is invoked, enabling test-time substitution.
TestClient is a thin re-export of Starlette's TestClient; pairs with dependency_overrides for endpoint-level test isolation.

questions.text: Why does the eval suite use isolated bench collections instead of the production collection?

haystack.content: ## Problem Eval re-ingests test fixtures into the production collection, polluting user data. ## Decision Use a reserved supamem_eval_* prefix for bench collections; see `src/supamem/eval/longmemeval_ingest.py` for the ingest pattern. Production indexer paths are never imported from eval modules.
Bench-only LongMemEval haystack ingest. Reachable only from supamem.eval.runner when suite=longmemeval_s. Production indexer paths are not touched.

questions.text: Why is the coderag corpus pinned to specific commit SHAs instead of tags or main branches?

haystack.content: ## Problem Tags can be retroactively moved; tracking main breaks reproducibility. ## Decision Pin two-repo haystack to specific commit SHAs recorded in `src/supamem/eval/coderag/corpus.py` PINNED_REPOS literal. Bumping a pin is a manual operation logged in CHANGELOG.md.
PINNED_REPOS = ((slug, repo_url), ...) tuple. fetch_pinned uses git fetch --depth=1 origin <sha> followed by checkout FETCH_HEAD. content_sha256 manifest provides second-line tamper detection.
